explanation: Russia still used the Julian calendar, then 13 days behind. The Bolsheviks seized power on 25 October by the old count, which was 7 November in the Gregorian calendar.

claims.text: The October Revolution, the Bolshevik seizure of power, took place on 25 October 1917 in Russia's Julian calendar, which was 7 November 1917 in the Gregorian calendar.
In 1917 the Julian calendar was 13 days behind the Gregorian calendar.
Russia was still using the Julian calendar in 1917.
